l-e-e5-b07-07.material: Matini: "The bus broke down, so the class waited 20 minutes for a new one." Swali: Why did the class wait? Jibu lazima liwe na maneno 7 au pungufu, litoe sababu iliyomo kwenye matini, na liwe sentensi kamili.

l-e-e5-b07-07.s.s1.explain: Ni jibu la kwanza tu ambalo ni sentensi kamili ya maneno 7 inayojumuisha sababu iliyomo kwenye matini (the bus broke down).
